## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant local checks or builds were run, or their absence is explained.
- [ ] Runtime behavior is covered by an existing or new smoke test.
- [ ] Immutable pins and generated artifacts were not changed unintentionally.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when installation or operation changed.
- [ ] No private keys, credentials or sensitive infrastructure details are included.

## Supply-chain impact

Describe any changes to upstream sources, pins, build images, Actions, signing, release permissions or artifact publication. Write `None` when not applicable.
